scope: common paper architecture for the Mem-ACE method figure, not a dataset-specific launch command

memory.coordinate_frame: world or scene-centered as explicitly labeled
memory.construction: posed training images + SfM/STGS geometry -> feature pooling -> pooled scene memory

stgs.source: SfM/COLMAP tracks from the same reconstruction

fusion.default_selected_by: long-run ablation; value_only_raw slightly outperforms z_only
fusion.interpretation_note: latent_p supplies centered anchor geometry through PE(latent_p - scene_center); it is not a scene-coordinate prediction or an independently supervised target

phases.Geometric Alignment: jointly train compressor, fusion, and SCR head with reprojection-based supervision
phases.Cached Memory Adaptation: cache anchored scene tokens, freeze compressor, adapt fusion and SCR head
